question: At what request rate does the fair use of tiles.waymorphic.com start blocking, and may its search and reverse results be stored?
why: The page states no number and no storage rule, only that there is no quota to keep under and that bulk downloads and scraping the whole planet will be blocked. The rate was not tested, because a burst test would load a free service that runs on a small server.
